description: This file is a shell script intended for testing Git's ancestry path functionality by setting up mock commit graphs and verifying the 'git log' and 'git rev-list' behaviors with various '--ancestry-path' options and commit ranges.

methods.name: test_merge
methods.description: Performs a merge of two commits with specified message and tags the result.

methods.name: test_ancestry
methods.description: Executes a 'git log' with specified arguments and compares output to expected.
